title: Document the Regex Scripts modding surface (find/replace on messages, per-character + preset scoped)
description: Skill says: nothing — decision-guide.md, custom-tools.md, character-cards.md, extensions.md, and SKILL.md never mention regex scripts. A user wanting SillyTavern-style find/replace transforms on prompts/output has no path documented; the decision hierarchy (decision-guide.md Seven Questions) omits it entirely. Reality (2.1): Marinara ships a full Regex Scripts system — a DB table (packages/server/src/db/schema/regex-scripts.ts `regexScripts`), seeded defaults (packages/server/src/db/seed-regex.ts `seedDefaultRegexScripts`), a client apply hook (packages/client/src/hooks/use-apply-regex.ts), per-character regex sections (packages/client/src/components/characters/CharacterRegexSection.tsx) and preset-level regex (packages/client/src/components/panels/PresetsPanel.tsx), documented in docs/REGEX_SCRIPTS.md and surfaced by the 2.1 doc-refresh (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Changed: 'Refreshed the v2.1.0 documentation set with ... regex scripts'). NOTE: introduction version is unconfirmed — it may predate 2.1 and only became documented in 2.1; orchestrator should confirm the version before dating the entry. Fix: add a Regex Scripts subsection (what it does, character vs preset scope, that it's SillyTavern-import-compatible) to decision-guide.md and/or custom-tools.md, pointing at docs/REGEX_SCRIPTS.md as source of truth.

title: Document the Home Assistant integration (auto-generated webhook custom tools)
description: Skill says: custom-tools.md (source-of-truth line 5) covers static/webhook/script custom tools but is silent on any built-in integration that generates tools; decision-guide.md never mentions Home Assistant. Reality (2.1): there is a first-class Home Assistant integration that generates webhook custom tools from HA entities and can re-sync them (docs/integrations/home-assistant.md; docs/CUSTOM_TOOLS.md: 'Set WEBHOOK_LOCAL_URLS_ENABLED=true only when you intentionally call local services such as Home Assistant'). CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed: 'Fixed Home Assistant documentation and defaults to point at Marinara's current port, note WEBHOOK_LOCAL_URLS_ENABLED=true for local webhooks, and explain that re-syncing updates existing generated tools.' Because HA URLs are local plain-HTTP, the integration REQUIRES WEBHOOK_LOCAL_URLS_ENABLED=true (runtime-config.ts reads process.env.WEBHOOK_LOCAL_URLS_ENABLED; tool-executor.ts SSRF gate). NOTE: the integration itself may predate 2.1; the 2.1 change is docs/defaults. Fix: add a short Home Assistant note to custom-tools.md (generated webhook tools, needs WEBHOOK_LOCAL_URLS_ENABLED=true, re-sync updates existing tools) citing docs/integrations/home-assistant.md.

title: Document animated Expression Engine portrait sprites (Video Generation -> looping GIF)
description: Skill says: character-cards.md 'Sprite System' (line 154) mentions only 'an automated sprite generation feature (uses image gen + a pose prompt)'. Reality (2.1): expression portrait sprites can now be generated as short VIDEO clips via a Video Generation connection, converted to looping GIFs, and saved into expression slots, with Advanced > Video Generation duration/prompt controls (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Added: 'Added animated Expression Engine portrait generation'). Source: packages/server/src/routes/sprites.routes.ts uses videoSettings.animatedExpressionClipDurationSeconds; default 3s in packages/shared/src/constants/video-generation-settings.ts; UI in packages/client/src/components/panels/SettingsPanel.tsx (animatedExpressionClipDurationSeconds). Fix: extend character-cards.md Sprite System to note the video-to-GIF animated-expression path and its Video Generation duration/prompt settings.

title: Roleplay sprite selection no longer capped at 3 sprite owners
description: Skill says: character-cards.md 'Sprite System' (line 154) is silent on any sprite-count limit. Reality (2.1): the hard-coded three-sprite limit was removed from Roleplay sprite selection, setup, and display so a chat can enable all uploaded sprite owners it needs (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed: 'Removed the hard-coded three-sprite limit from Roleplay sprite selection, setup, and display paths' (#3169)). Fix: if the skill ever states a sprite/owner cap, drop it; optionally note multi-character sprite overlays are unrestricted in 2.1.

title: Document root-level Connections panel custom sort order + folder drag
description: Skill says: architecture.md discusses Connections but is silent on connection folders and ordering. Reality (2.1): unfiled (root-level) connections can now be reordered by drag or moved into folders via a saved Custom sort order (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed: 'Fixed root-level Connections panel dragging by adding a Custom sort order backed by saved sortOrder' (#3295)). Source: packages/shared/src/types/connection.ts (sortOrder: number), packages/server/src/db/schema/connection-folders.ts (sortOrder integer). Fix: add a one-line note in architecture.md that Connections support folders + drag/custom-sort ordering; low priority, ideation rarely touches it.

title: Document Roleplay /as command semantics (post-exact vs generate)
description: Skill says: nothing — no reference file documents the Roleplay /as slash command. Reality (2.1): '/as Character "message"' posts that exact message as the named character, while bare '/as Character' asks the model to generate that character's next response (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed: 'Fixed Roleplay /as so /as Character "message" posts the exact message as that character, while bare /as Character still asks the model to generate that character's next response'). Fix: if the skill adds a Roleplay slash-command list, include /as with both forms; otherwise low priority.

title: Document Roleplay/Game tracker field locks (lock survives rename/replace)
description: Skill says: lorebooks.md documents a lorebook entry `locked` field (line 61) but no reference documents Roleplay/Game trackers or per-field tracker locks. Reality (2.1): trackers support locking individual fields, and 2.1 hardened it so AI tracker updates can no longer bypass a locked field by renaming or replacing the locked row at the same position (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed: 'Fixed Roleplay tracker locks so AI tracker updates cannot bypass a locked field by renaming or replacing the locked row at the same position'). Fix: note that Roleplay/Game trackers support per-field locks (agents such as tracker/custom-agent updates respect them) wherever trackers are described (agents.md or architecture.md).

title: Document Game Mode NPC portrait generation (canonical visual guidance from game state)
description: NOTE: partial overlap with the Game Illustrator area (agent 3); this concerns the underlying NPC-portrait pipeline, not the /illustrate button. Skill says: silent on NPC portrait generation. Reality (2.1): GM-created NPC profile descriptions from initial world setup are rebuilt from current game state at asset-send time, sent as required canonical visual guidance for portrait prompts, and preserved when generated avatars are written back to NPC metadata (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed: 'Fixed Game Mode NPC portrait generation ...'). Fix: if the Game Mode section documents asset/portrait generation, note NPC portraits are grounded in live game state; defer to agent-3's Game coverage if it already covers this.

title: Document merged-group reaction attribution (reactions credited to the correct speaker)
description: NOTE: the [react:] command feature itself is agent-4's area; this entry is the attribution model behind it. Skill says: silent on how emoji reactions are attributed in merged multi-character replies. Reality (2.1): commands placed above the first 'Name:' line of a merged reply now attribute to the speaker whose section they open (leaked [HH:MM] timestamps no longer skew this); merged group chats instruct models to write the [react:] tag inside the reacting character's own section and allow several characters to react in one reply; a react aimed at the user's persona name (or 'User') targets the user's latest message (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed, #3220). Fix: if the skill documents group reactions, note per-section attribution and persona-targeted reactions.

title: Document merged-group autonomous-message accounting fix
description: Skill says: character-cards.md ties extensions.talkativeness to 'autonomous messaging rate' (line 70) but gives no detail on how autonomous turns are accounted in group chats. Reality (2.1): in a merged group Conversation, the SELECTED autonomous character now receives the saved message attribution, follow-up count, and daily-budget count, instead of every autonomous turn being charged to the first group member (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed, #3299). Fix: low priority — optionally note that autonomous messaging has a per-character daily budget and follow-up accounting when discussing talkativeness/group autonomy.

title: Update agents.md: built-in agent phase overrides in the editor are now respected
description: Skill says: the v2.0 agents guidance treats certain built-ins (e.g. Continuity, Prose Guardian) as phase-locked/force-pinned (see prior audit marinara-v2.0-skill-audit-v1.jsonl line 11). Reality (2.1): changing a built-in agent's phase in the agent editor is now honored in storage, normal generation, and manual agent retries instead of being reset to the built-in default, for agents including Echo Chamber, Prose Guardian, Continuity, Immersive HTML, Expression, and Music DJ (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed: 'Fixed agent pipeline phase overrides ...'). Fix: soften/qualify any 'force-pinned phase' claim in agents.md — user phase overrides on built-ins now persist and take effect.

title: Document Echo Chamber no longer firing on /continue
description: Skill says: agents.md lists echo-chamber (parallel, audience reactions) with no /continue caveat. Reality (2.1): Echo Chamber is now limited to fresh user messages and does NOT trigger on /continue continuation rewrites (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed: 'Prevented Echo Chamber from triggering on /continue generations'). Source: packages/shared/src/features/agents/echo-chamber/manifest.ts (id 'echo-chamber'); packages/client/src/hooks/use-generate.ts routes echo-chamber results to the echo store. Fix: add the /continue exclusion note to the echo-chamber entry in agents.md.

title: Document lorebook entry content no longer truncated on agent/tool writes
description: Skill says: lorebooks.md and custom-tools.md (save_lorebook_entry built-in, line 131) are silent on any size cap for agent/tool-written lorebook entries. Reality (2.1): the agent/tool write-path size cap on lorebook entry content was removed, so large entries are no longer truncated before storage (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed: 'Removed the agent/tool write-path size cap on lorebook entry content ...'). Fix: if the skill ever implied entries written by save_lorebook_entry / Lorebook Keeper are size-limited, remove that; note large entries persist intact in 2.1.

title: Document that uploaded text attachments now use the full model context (no 60k pre-truncation)
description: Skill says: silent on file-attachment handling. Reality (2.1): readable text-file attachments were previously pre-truncated to 60,000 characters before prompt-context fitting; 2.1 removed that so large uploaded text files can use the selected model's actual context window (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed: 'Fixed readable text-file attachments being pre-truncated to 60,000 characters ...'). Fix: low priority — if the skill discusses attaching documents to a chat, note large text files are bounded by the model's context window, not a fixed 60k cap.

title: Document 1:1 Conversation prompt-history speaker labeling (2.1 prompt-assembly tweak)
description: Skill says: architecture.md Prompt Assembly (per prior audit) needs a 2.0 rework already; this is an additional 2.1 delta. Reality (2.1): in 1:1 Conversation chats, assistant turns in prompt history are now speaker-labeled with the character name, preserving multi-turn user/assistant roles while making prior DM replies unambiguous to the model (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed: 'Fixed 1:1 Conversation prompt history so assistant turns are speaker-labeled with the character name ...'). Fix: fold into the prompt-assembly refresh — note 1:1 assistant turns are name-labeled in 2.1.

title: Document impersonate + smart-group prompt-assembly refinements
description: Skill says: silent on /impersonate and smart-group directive precedence. Reality (2.1): (a) impersonate prompt assembly now has fallback chat presets drop conflicting non-marker sections while explicitly selected impersonate presets keep their normal prompt sections (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed, #3209); (b) Smart group response order no longer lets hidden responder selection override /guided or /impersonate directives in Roleplay group chats (#3212). Fix: low priority — if the skill documents /guided or /impersonate in group chats, note these directives now take precedence over smart auto-selection.

title: Document Professor Mari structured preset creation (app_data preset.create/update) + mari CLI
description: Skill says: character-cards.md Mari section (lines 95-96) says the workspace agent can create/edit agents/extensions/tools/themes via a `mari` CLI and that Mari can 'create/update' presets, without detail. Reality (2.1): Mari preset creation now supports structured app_data `preset.create`/`preset.update` commands that can build prompt groups, prompt sections, and preset variables/choice blocks in one reversible operation (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed, #3207). Also 2.1 added a root `pnpm mari -- --help` wrapper exposing the built Mari CLI from source checkouts (#3208) and fixed the Mari CLI flag parser so boolean flags like --tail/--raw/--patch/--strict/--staged no longer swallow positional args (#3222). Fix: note Mari can scaffold full presets (groups/sections/variables) reversibly; mention `pnpm mari -- --help` for contributors.
